items.evidence: python roll.py --headless --ticks N --script "T:word,..." [--board B] [--settings-dir D] prints one JSON object with tick, screen, board, score, lives, ball, coins, crates, bridge_x, volume, language, selected, texts, sounds.
--frame out.png after headless runs on title/settings/play b2 and b3/paused/won/lost: every PNG header reads 800 x 480.
sounds/*.wav and --write-sound coin|bounce|fall|clear: durations 0.37/0.20/0.80/0.80 s, peaks 15k-28k, zero-crossing rates 1238/110/414/754 per s (different pitches), samples all pairwise different.
ticks 0: title, selected Start; menu_down -> Settings, x2 -> Quit, x3 -> Start; menu_up -> Quit; 0:enter -> play, board 1, score 0, lives 3, coins of board 1.
Settings (fresh folder): Volume 8, Language English; 4x menu_right -> 10 (capped), 12x menu_left -> 0 (floored); on Language menu_right -> es; Back+enter -> title (selected Settings).

With es: title [Roll, Empezar, Ajustes, Salir]; settings [Ajustes, Volumen: 0, Idioma: Espanol, Volver]; play [Tablero 2 de 3, Puntos: 0, Vidas: 3]; paused adds En pausa/Continuar/Salir al titulo; won Has ganado; lost Fin del juego; Pulsa Enter para volver al titulo (Roll is the name, Enter the key).
After a run with --settings-dir s1 set volume 0 and es, a later run with s1 starts at volume 0, language es; a run without the option starts at 8, en (no settings were changed in the default folder).
--board 1 no input: y first <= 0.3 at tick 27 (0.250), back up to 0.494 at tick 40, two more smaller bounces, y = 0.25 at tick 600; sounds = 3x bounce.
Board 1, push at 80 to 110 then none: right x 0 -> 0.486 at 110 -> 1.736 at 150; left/up/down give -x, -z, +z symmetrically; still moving ~0.3 per 10 ticks 40 ticks after the push ends.

Board 1 steering script (judge-scratch/s1route.txt): score 10/20/30/40, one coin leaves coins each time; at tick 610 board 2, sounds end coin,clear, ball (-3,1.25,0) i.e. at rest at start, 3 board-2 coins and 6 crates.
--board 2 no input, every 50 ticks to 300: crates at (0,0.2499,+-0.5/0) and (0,0.7499,..), all within 0.001 of their places.

--board 2 80:right,140:none 680 ticks: middle crates moved 1.11 and 0.80, ball never reaches x=1 (stops at 0.608) whereas on an empty board (scratch copy with crates removed) it arrives at tick 173; no crate below y 0.2499 while over the board. Holding right: 2 crates moved 6+ m, x>=1 at 185 vs 167 empty.
--board 2 80:right held: two middle crates pushed off +x edge, fall, vanish from crates at ticks 307 and 320 when below -5; the other four stay at their places.

Board 2: fall at tick 318 -> lives 2, fall sound, ball reset to (-3,1.25,0), coin (1.5,0) stays taken, remaining crates unchanged. Run from board 1 with a fall then clearing: board 2 starts with lives 2.

Board 3 script 250:right,290:none,345:left,385:none puts the ball on the bridge; with no input over any 180-tick window from tick 400 to 1180 |dx_ball - dx_bridge| <= 0.247, y stays 0.25. 80:right,120:none (bridge near 2) -> ball falls into the gap, life lost at tick 234.
--board 3 script 250:right,290:none,345:left,385:none,400:right: won at ~tick 620, score 30; at 630 and 900 (with further pushes) state unchanged; 950:enter -> title.
--board 2 80:right held: third fall at tick 668 -> lost, lives 0; at tick 1500 with and without later left/up pushes, score, ball, coins and crates identical; enter -> title.

Board 2 mid-strike, escape at 175: screen paused, ball and crates identical at ticks 176 and 400; enter (Resume) at 400 continues from the same state. Board 3 escape at 100: bridge_x 1.11111 at 100 and 300; menu_down+enter (Quit to title) -> title.
Two runs of --board 2 --ticks 680 --script 80:right,140:none printed byte-identical JSON including struck crates (1.10814,0.24995,0) and (0.79923,0.74995,0).

Looked at b2_strike.png: perspective view from above/front of the whole board, shaded ball with stripe and shadow, wooden crates with lit/dark faces at their state places, 3 coins. b3_240.png and b3_ride.png: two slabs, gap, bridge positioned per bridge_x 1.33 / 0.44.

Looked at frames: title EMPEZAR/AJUSTES/SALIR, settings AJUSTES/VOLUMEN/IDIOMA/VOLVER, paused EN PAUSA/CONTINUAR/SALIR AL TITULO, won HAS GANADO/PUNTOS: 30, lost FIN DEL JUEGO; English settings frame in English; play frames show BOARD n OF 3, SCORE, LIVES.

sound.py Player.play returns without playing when volume <= 0 and wav_bytes scales by volume/10 (gui.py:73 passes g.volume); --write-sound --volume 0 gives all-zero samples; at volume 0 the state still lists sounds.
README gives keys and goals, the headless/frame/sound commands (all ran as written) and a file-by-file description.

defects: Crates never rotate: the brief asks that the ball topples them; here an upper crate only slides or drops (README admits it).
On the bridge, friction of up to 3.5 m/s2 nearly cancels the 4 m/s2 push, so a ball on the bridge can barely be steered relative to it.
A held push stays held through a fall reset, so the ball starts moving again at once (the player still holds the key, so this is arguable).
Running the game creates work/__pycache__ (Python bytecode). The judge removed it after the runs.
